what: Pressing the menu button brings an ink-colored panel down from the top over .5s to cover the screen, the big link letters pop up from below one character at a time (.018s apart), and the closing line floats up after. Closing sends the letters up and the panel lifts away from the bottom · with look: fade the panel shows through in place over 1.2s (background .98) and the link rows rise from below over 1.6s starting .25s later with .08s offsets, and on close only the panel lifts over 1.2s after .1s (all power4.out)
ease: Panel power3.inOut .5s · text back.out(1.6) .6s · close text power2.in .3s, panel .45s

options.dur: Length in seconds for the opening panel to come down and cover, default 0.5 — text and closing are sped up by the same ratio. Fully open in dur × max(1.8, 1.7 + 0.036 × (link character count − 1)) seconds (about 1 second for 8 characters)
options.close: Length in seconds for the closing panel to lift, default 0.45 — text and ending are pulled in at the same ratio. It fully closes in about close × 1.44 seconds (default .65s)
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open/close button (child) — if crack-split is attached, it listens to that fx:toggle
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Backdrop that comes down (child of the panel, color --kf-contrast-bg)
options.a: Links inside the panel are split per letter and bounce up — grouped word by word in .fx-word so lines break only at spaces, and masking is per word (line)
options.look: if ”circle”, it is the original Brand menu — from the button position a circle pops up over dur (default 1.4s), shrinks slightly (18%·30%) and spreads to fill the screen, while the button jumps twice and half ([data-fx-part=half] two split apart by ∓18°. Links come in from 160px to the right starting at .8s with .1s offsets, and the closing element rises from below starting at 1.05s (power4.out 1s). On close the text disappears at .35s and the circle rewinds over close (default .9s). Hovering a link rolls the letters 1.1em in random order and a shadow copy rises · If ”fade”, it is the original iok menu — the panel shows through over dur (default 1.2s) with power4.out (background .98), and each link (line) runs yPercent 100 → 0 over 1.6s power4.out starting .25s later with .08s offsets. On close, after .1s only the panel lifts away over close (default 1.2s)
options.[data-fx-part=half] (inside button): look: with circle, the two halves of the button that split at ∓18° when opening (heart halves, etc.)
